comment: Strand hair grown on our own MakeHuman bodies (docs/design/hair-physics.md 'Growing our own grooms'). tools/makehuman/grow_hair.py writes game/Saved/Grooms/<base>/<Style>.abc from the base's FBX; the HairGrooms commandlet imports each as /Game/Rim3D/Generated/Grooms/GA_<base>_<Style>. 'creator' maps the creator's hair style names (the wig meshes) to a grown style; a creator style missing here keeps its wig at every distance.
